messages:
harper: quick alert 1: telemetry showing a subtle but sustained uptick in p95 for model rwi-pegasus on runtime 3.4.5 in us-central starting ~11:03 UTC. not huge but above our soft threshold.
sre-oncall: seeing it too. error rate flat, tail latency slowly rising. any recent runtime or SDK changes?
raj: runtime 3.4.5 finished rollout at 10:50 UTC. SDK unchanged. could be a scheduling/batching regression with certain request sizes.
ivy: can we target a regional mitigation instead of global rollback? suggest a short regional pin to 3.4.4 and run focused traces.
deploybot: Deploybot: Compatibility advisory for model=rwi-pegasus runtime=3.4.5 region=us-central. Recommended actions: 1) regional pin to runtime 3.4.4, 2) apply safelist routing for low-qps customers, 3) create rollback lane. Command: `/deploy pin --model rwi-pegasus --runtime 3.4.4 --region us-central --duration 24h --reason "p95-tail-regression"`
harper: prefer pin + phased-canary unpin if stable. please add a monitor that re-pins if p95 > 1.25x baseline for 10m.
raj: executing pin now. running:
```
/deploy pin --model rwi-pegasus --runtime 3.4.4 --region us-central --duration 24h --reason "p95-tail-regression"
```
returning task id 120334.
deploybot: Deploybot: Pin executed (task 120334). Safelist rule applied: customers with <4qps routed to runtime 3.4.4. Rollback lane rb-120334 created.
qa-bot: QA-bot: kicking off quick longseq + batching smoke test (job rq-9012). ETA ~18m.
ivy: infra, please enable sampling of request traces where tokens > 1024 and batching > 8. could be an edge-case in batching logic.
sre-oncall: enabled 1% sampling for those traces and started a short histogram capture.
raj: added monitor: `monitor.policy.add("pegasus-us-central", metric="p95", window=10m, threshold=1.25, action="re-pin")`. also added a rollout note in #release-notes: "us-central: temporary regional pin of rwi-pegasus to runtime 3.4.4 while we investigate p95 increase on 3.4.5."
harper: QA results?
qa-bot: regression complete: sampled prompts show no functional divergence. batching smoke shows 2 traces with prolonged queue wait; uploaded to ticket INF-5897.
ivy: great, looks like a scheduling hotpath. infra to try a small canary patch that reduces queue wait timeout.
sre-oncall: early telemetry after pin: pinned cohort p95 improved from 560ms -> 360ms, overall region p95 down ~10%. watching for error spikes.
harper: timeline: keep pin for 3h while infra patches canary; if stable, schedule phased-unpin tomorrow with 1%->5%->20% warmup and 15m holds. auto re-pin if guardrail breaches.
raj: noted and will coordinate the phased-unpin job. closing thread for now; post any aborts or final unpin plan here. :white_check_mark:
